name: EDGE Energy
old_description: Since 1992, ENERGY STAR and its partners have helped American families and businesses save 5 trillion kilowatt-hours of electricity and avoid more than $500 billion in energy costs.
about:
EDGE Energy is headquartered in Beltsville, Maryland, and was founded in 2006 by Jason Dispenza, who serves as Founder and CEO. The company began as a mission-driven contractor focused on helping homeowners across the Maryland, Washington, D.C., and Virginia region reduce energy costs and transition to renewable energy.

The firm provides a full suite of residential energy services under one roof, including rooftop and ground-mount solar photovoltaic design and installation, solar system cleaning, monitoring, and repair, high-efficiency HVAC and heat pump installation, heat pump water heaters, insulation, air sealing, home energy audits, battery storage, and roofing. All design, installation, and service work is performed by EDGE employees rather than subcontractors. Since 2006, the company has completed more than 5,000 projects.

EDGE Energy serves residential homeowners throughout the DMV (D.C., Maryland, Virginia) area. Its customers are typically single-family home owners seeking to lower utility bills, improve comfort, electrify their homes, or add solar and storage. The company also works with homeowners across income levels through various incentive and assistance programs.

The company states its mission is to improve homeowners' lives by lowering energy bills, supporting the shift to clean, abundant renewable energy, and delivering an award-winning experience through a dependable process and fast, quality installations. It emphasizes accountability after installation, standing behind its work long after project completion.

about:
EDL Packaging, a division of Massman Companies, is based in De Pere, Wisconsin. The company has over six decades of experience in the design and manufacture of secondary packaging equipment, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The company produces a range of shrink-wrapping and multi-packing machinery, including shrink wrappers, shrink bundlers, roll wrappers, automatic flight bar wrappers, forming shoe wrappers, tray formers, and loaders. It offers both standard and custom-engineered solutions, with specific machine models such as the SV342 wrap-around tray former, SV346 twin-stream flight bar, and SV348 double tight wrap servo system. The equipment is designed to bundle consumer and industrial products in low-density polyethylene film.

EDL serves industries including pet food, building materials, food, beverage, personal care, carpet and underlayment, grain, medical/pharmaceutical, and food service. Its customers are manufacturers of consumer and industrial products seeking end-of-line packaging automation.

EDL emphasizes safe, efficient, and high-quality machinery, with comprehensive designs that ensure quick installation, smooth startup, and system reliability. As part of Massman Companies, it can provide a single agreement for all machines needed on a production line, streamlining operations for customers.

name: EHOB, Inc.
old_description: Celebrating 40 years of leadership in pressure injury prevention and safe patient handling, we are proud to continue our mission of protecting both patients, staff, and healthcare teams. With a strong legacy of partnership and dedication, our solutions have set the standard in the industry, making safety our top priority. As we look ahead, we remain committed to advancing care, ensuring comfort, and safeguarding facilities. Thank you for trusting us as your partner in prevention.
about:
Founded in 1985 in Indianapolis, Indiana, EHOB, Inc. has spent four decades developing pressure injury prevention and safe patient handling solutions for healthcare facilities. The privately held company began with a focus on heel offloading and has expanded its portfolio through continuous collaboration with clinicians.

The company designs and manufactures heel offloading devices, patient positioning systems, and moisture management products aimed at reducing pressure injuries and improving staff safety. Its solutions are developed through direct dialogue with healthcare partners and are supported by clinical evidence gathered from trials conducted in hundreds of U.S. facilities between 2021 and 2025.

EHOB serves hospitals, long-term care centers, and other clinical settings where pressure injury prevention is a priority. Its customers include bedside clinicians, wound care teams, and facility administrators who rely on the company’s clinical support resources, protocols, and expert consultation to implement evidence-based prevention programs.

The company differentiates itself by combining 40 years of experience with data-driven product development, offering a customized experience for each facility. Its clinical resource center provides peer-reviewed research, outcome data, and educational materials to help healthcare professionals translate evidence into practice.

name: ELECTRO CIRCUITS
old_description: When the demands of your business or conscience demand “Made in U.S.A.” Electro Circuits is there.
about:
Electro Circuits operates from Stafford, Texas, and was founded in 2005. The company is a printed circuit board manufacturer offering design, fabrication, and assembly services. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer boards up to 20 layers and beyond, using materials such as polyamide, Teflon, Rogers, flex, rigid-flex, and Kapton with gold or palladium. It provides PCB electrical testing, controlled impedance boards, and special long-length and width PCBs. Finishes include ENIG, ENEPIG, silver, and carbon. Electro Circuits handles prototype, quick-turn, and high-volume production runs, delivering electrically tested boards.

The firm serves customers in defense and electronics sectors, evidenced by its ITAR registration and MIL-SPEC capability. Long-term clients include REI and PMQ Alternatives, Inc., who cite reliable quality and minimal interaction as reasons for repeat business.

Electro Circuits emphasizes domestic manufacturing with a "Made in U.S.A." option alongside offshore alternatives, fast turnaround times, competitive pricing, and an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system. Customers highlight the company's no-handholding ordering process and on-time delivery.

name: EMS, Inc (Electronic Manufacturing Solutions)
old_description: With over 19 years of experience in delivering superior products.
about:
EMS, Inc. (Electronic Manufacturing Solutions) was founded in 2006 and operates from a 20,000-square-foot facility in Lincoln, Arkansas. The company functions as a full-service electronics contract manufacturer, though founder names and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing, including PCB design and layout, surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly (with BGA/QFN capability), conformal coating, cable and wire harness assembly, box-build and electro-mechanical integration, test fixture development, design-for-manufacturing analysis, component procurement, and PCB rework and repair. All processes occur under one roof, supporting prototype through high-volume runs.

EMS serves OEMs across agriculture, fitness, oil and gas, automotive, trucking, HVAC, medical, aviation, food packaging, telecommunications, emergency services, energy, product marking, industrial motor manufacturing, automation, railroad, IoT, transportation and logistics, and industrial automation. Documented projects include a cavity-mounted sensor for transportation logistics, motor control boards for oil and gas, and a cardio equipment console for fitness.

The company emphasizes clear quoting, on-time delivery, and direct engineer access to shorten supply chains. It also markets a willingness to handle labor-intensive "dirty jobs" that other suppliers avoid, a position built on more than 150 customers and 200-plus projects since 2006.

about:
EVCO Plastics operates a manufacturing facility in Calhoun, Georgia, known as CAL1. The site is part of EVCO Plastics, a company specializing in custom plastic injection molding.

The Calhoun plant spans 110,000 square feet and houses 17 injection molding machines with clamping forces up to 3,300 tons. The facility offers a range of molding processes including plastic injection molding, gas assist molding, multi-shot molding, insert molding, overmolding, in-mold decorating and labeling, liquid silicone rubber molding, and stack molding. Secondary operations such as UV coating, assembly, and packaging are also performed on-site. Tool and mold building, design for manufacturability, scientific injection molding, metrology, and robotics automation support the production workflow.

The facility serves medical and healthcare, consumer products, industrial products, and plastic packaging sectors. Medical device manufacturers are among its customers, with the company highlighting early supplier involvement and metal-to-plastic conversion expertise for healthcare applications.

EVCO Plastics emphasizes early collaboration in the product development lifecycle, providing engineering services, material selection guidance, and prototyping to help partners achieve competitive advantages. The Calhoun location maintains ISO 9001 certification with design scope and operates an ISO Class 8 clean room for sensitive molding applications.

name: East Jordan Plastics
old_description: It all started four generations ago when Ken and Shirley Diller founded East Jordan Box and Crate Co. to produce wooden greenhouse flats for bedding plant growers in the Midwest. From those wooden flats to today’s comprehensive line of sustainable plastic plant containers, East Jordan Plastics remains committed to the only industry it has ever served—horticulture.
about:
East Jordan Plastics operates from East Jordan, Michigan, where it was founded four generations ago by Ken and Shirley Diller as East Jordan Box and Crate Co. The business began by producing wooden greenhouse flats for bedding plant growers in the Midwest and has remained in the family ever since.

Today the company manufactures a comprehensive line of sustainable plastic plant containers for greenhouses and nurseries. Its injection-molded product families include the SHUTTLE™ series of pots, hanging baskets, planters and bowls; the patented SHUTTLE POT® STADIUM® line of grower pots and trays with offset-printable flat sides; and a range of trays, carriers, flats, inserts, and plug and propagation trays precision-engineered for automated destacking, filling, transplanting and transport equipment. A closed-loop recycling program, certified for Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) plastic by AM Testing, feeds reclaimed material back into production.

The company serves only the horticultural market—greenhouse growers, nursery operators, bedding plant producers and retail garden centers. Customers such as Bradford Greenhouses and Linwell Gardens use the containers for propagation, automated production and finished goods, citing space savings and labeling advantages from the STADIUM line.

East Jordan Plastics says its differentiation rests on four pillars: a closed-loop recycling system with third-party PCR certification, product designs tailored for high-speed automation, precision tooling that holds exact tolerances for plug trays, and a family-owned structure that has kept the focus on horticulture for nearly 80 years.
